title: Festie
shortDescription: Plan festivals with your crew in real time — sets, schedules, and meetups.
fullDescription:
Festie keeps your festival crew on the same page — in real time.

No more lost-in-the-crowd, no more "where are you?" texts that never send on packed festival networks. Festie is built for the people who do festivals together: pick the sets you can't miss, build a shared schedule, and stay coordinated from gates-open to the last encore.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
• Pick your sets — browse the lineup and tap the artists you want to catch.
• Build a shared schedule — see your day at a glance and spot the clashes early.
• Coordinate your crew — everyone sees the plan update live as it changes.
• Stay in sync in real time — changes show up instantly across the whole crew.
• Export to your calendar — send your picks straight to your phone's calendar (.ics).
• Get notified — push alerts so you never miss a set you marked.

BUILT FOR FESTIVALS
Festie is fast, works the way festivals actually work, and is designed to keep your group moving together instead of scattering. Whether it's three friends or a thirty-person camp, everyone shares one plan that stays current.

Make the most of every festival — together.

Learn more at festie.us
